statements.impact_statement: Netty codec-compression vulnerability fixed in 4.2.13.Final. Liquibase is a database migration CLI tool that does not run any network server. Netty is a transitive dependency from Azure SDK, Cassandra driver, and MongoDB driver — used only as a client-side transport for outbound connections. There is no inbound socket for an attacker to exploit.

See CVE-2026-59901 entry on netty-codec above — same root cause (Bzip2Decoder RLE infinite loop), mirrored here so scanners that flag netty-codec-compression (the module Bzip2Decoder lives in for Netty 4.2.x) receive the same not_affected statement. Liquibase dependency management includes Netty versions below the fixed 4.2.16.Final release (cloud-integrations/liquibase-azure-extension/pom.xml:65, cloud-integrations/liquibase-azure-deps/pom.xml:50, commercial-databases/liquibase-commercial-bigquery/pom.xml:72). No Liquibase Netty consumer adds Bzip2Decoder/Bzip2Encoder to a pipeline.
